creep.source: EN 1992-1-1 Annex B Eqs B.1-B.9, Sec 3.1.4(3)
creep.note: fcm = fck + 8 MPa (Table 3.1). The cement class is N by default: override concreteTime.creep.cementClass (Project Settings > Code values). The temperature adjustment of the age (Eq B.10) is not applied (20 °C).

shrinkage.source: EN 1992-1-1 Sec 3.1.4(6) Eqs 3.8-3.13, Table 3.3, Annex B Eqs B.11-B.12
shrinkage.note: kh is interpolated linearly between the h0 of Table 3.3 and held beyond 500 mm. The drying starts at the end of curing (ts); the autogenous shrinkage from casting.

exposure.source: EN 1992-1-1 Figure 3.1: inside conditions RH = 50 %, outside conditions RH = 80 %

strengthGain.source: EN 1992-1-1 Sec 3.1.2(6) Eq 3.2: s = 0.25 for cement class N (0.20 R, 0.38 S)
strengthGain.note: The modulus at an age from the pack's Ec rule at that strength (EN 1992-1-1 Eq 3.5 takes (fcm(t) / fcm)^0.3: SAEngine practice). No gain beyond 28 days.

ageing.source: SAEngine practice: the usual ageing coefficient of the age-adjusted effective modulus method
ageing.note: EN 1992-1-1 does not give χ; 0.8 is the usual value for loads applied at once.

analysis.note: The steel restrains the creep and shrinkage by the age-adjusted effective modulus.
